arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكاً، وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَاناً.
transliteration: Ithaa sami'tum siyaahad-deekati fas'alullaaha min fadhlihi... wa ithaa sami'tum naheeqal-himaari fata'awwathoo billaahi minash-shaytaan...
translation: When you hear the crowing of roosters, ask Allah for His bounty, for they have seen an angel. And when you hear the braying of donkeys, seek refuge in Allah from the devil, for they have seen a devil.
